messages:
Maya R.: Heads-up: a few interviewers reported they didn't receive the interviewer readiness checklist attached to today's panels. Noticed 3 panels affected so far.
Alejandra (recruiter): saw candidates C-9244, C-9245, C-9250 missing the rubric. I'm on calls but can share IDs here.
Samir K.: same. 9:00 panel didn't have the guide. ATS shows webhook delivered but checklist service returned 429.
ops-bot: [automated] webhook delivery failure -> 429 Too Many Requests for /api/v1/checklists/attach (retry 3/3).
Maya R.: Is this the checklist microservice rate-limiting or ATS spamming us?
Ethan L.: quick glance at metrics: checklist-service has per-customer concurrent limit of 5. Recruiting created multiple invites in quick succession for the job, burst pushed us over.
Alejandra (recruiter): can we attach manually for the remaining panels? I don't want interviewers showing up without rubrics.
Ethan L.: I can kick a backfill job to re-trigger the attach webhook for these candidate IDs. Post the IDs and times and I'll re-run. I'll also capture response codes.
Alejandra (recruiter): listing here: C-9244 10:00, C-9245 11:15, C-9250 14:30.
Ethan L.: re-triggering now. Results: C-9244 -> 200, C-9245 -> 429 then retried -> 200, C-9250 -> 429 -> retried -> 429 (final).
Samir K.: for the final fail, can we fallback to the manual-sheet copy?
Alejandra (recruiter): did that for C-9250, pasted rubric into calendar invite.
Maya R.: short-term: good. Longer-term ops, can we: 1) raise concurrency quota for recruiting tenant, 2) implement exponential backoff with jitter in the checklist client, 3) alert when webhook 429 rate > threshold.
ops-bot: [automated] deployment queued: checklist-service/patch/backoff-2026 by Ethan L.
Ethan L.: created PR github.com/redwood/checklist-service/pull/460 — adds jittered backoff + per-tenant higher concurrency flag for recruiting.
Samir K.: I'll add a monitor rule: checklist_webhook_429_rate > 3 in 5m -> slack #people-ops + paging to oncall.
Maya R.: Ethan, please upload the backfill run log and a csv of failed ids to /shared/people-ops/checklist-backfill/1729600001-results.csv and confirm when PR is ready to merge.
Ethan L.: uploaded results + csv, PR is ready for review. Link DM
Alejandra (recruiter): thanks all. Also can we add a one-pager for recruiters about batching invites to avoid this until patch deploys? I can draft.
Maya R.: yes please. Action items: Ethan - push patch + enable higher quota for recruiting tenant; Samir - alert rule; Alejandra - recruiter guidance doc; Maya - follow-up tomorrow to confirm no regressions.
ops-bot: [automated] alert created: checklist_webhook_429_rate > 3 in 5m -> notified #people-ops.
